title: Not as advertised.
text:
When I decided to try out a plant subscription, I chose Costa Farms because it seemed like the best “deal” and would be something I enjoyed, even after the price jump after the first box.

When the first box arrived, both of my “O2” plants were the same plant, not a deal breaker, but disappointing none the less. That shipment came with a total of 3 plants (2 Arrowhead and 1 torch cactus). It was missing the “free watering can” that was promised. An email to the company was replied to very quickly stating that they had run out of them and one would be shipped in my next subscription. Cool, I can wait a month, no big deal. A few weeks later, I received an email letting me know they had the watering cans back in stock and I should expect one in my next order. Cool, I like the communication!

However, today my second subscription box arrived and guess what WASN’T in the box?! You guessed it, no watering can. Now, they did send 4 plants this time (2 very small cacti; ball and bieblii, a coffee plant and a corn plant)….all very pretty and I do love them, but having now paid almost $40 and not received what is probably a 30¢ plastic water cup is very disappointing and I will likely be canceling this subscription to find a more trust worthy company to exchange money with. What a disappointment it was to have it not be there again! At least this month I got the box with MY packing slip in it instead of someone else’s information inside.
label: neutral
